subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It reminded students that laws are not just words in books.”?
options: They affect real people, and they must be questioned, protected, and improved.
A mistake during practice is useful if people learn before real danger comes.
Sometimes people need to see waste clearly before they believe it is real.
Internet connection may be invisible, but its effects appear in real places among real people.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「It reminded students that laws are not just words in books. They affect real people, and they must be questioned, protected, and…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A mistake during practice is useful if people learn before real danger comes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes people need to see waste clearly before they believe it is real.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Internet connection may be invisible, but its effects appear in real places among real people.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It reminded students that laws are not just words in books. They affect real people, and they must be questioned, protected, and improved.」，答案為「They affect real people, and they must be questioned, protected, and improved.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They affect real people, and they must be questioned, protected, and improved.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
